        By design
        
      
        Responsible-AI guardrails
        
      
        Speed never comes at the cost of fairness or privacy. These are built into every agent.
        
    
        
    
        
      
        👤
        Human-in-the-loop
        The agent recommends; a person decides at every step. No automated rejections.
        
      
        ◎
        Evidence for everything
        Each suggestion shows the evidence and the gaps, so a reviewer can verify the call.
        
      
        🛡
        PII-safe & anonymized
        Sensitive data is redacted and evaluation runs on anonymized profiles.
        
      
        §
        Regulation-aligned
        Aligned to DPDPA, GDPR, and the EU AI Act from the ground up.
